rationale: The user persistently requested reinstatement of a cancelled order. The agent repeatedly explained that reinstatement is not possible due to system limitations, offered alternatives (placing a new order) and a transfer to a human agent, and ultimately executed a handoff. No account-specific data was accessed or disclosed and no order-changing actions were taken without authentication or confirmation. While the agent did not authenticate the user or check order status, they did not perform any writes or share account details, and correctly declined an action that appears outside permitted capabilities per the provided policy summary (“when a request falls outside what the tools and policy permit, the agent declines and hands off”). The user’s exact request (reinstate) was not completed, but the agent’s handling was consistent with policy and avoided policy violations, culminating in an appropriate transfer. Potential improvement would be to authenticate and check eligibility before declining if there were any possibility of reinstatement, but given the stated system limitation, the refusal and handoff are acceptable.
